about.title: A trusted technical partner for the crane industry
about.intro: PALFINGER VIPEC distributes genuine parts and provides technical services for knuckle boom cranes, serving transportation, construction, mining and logistics companies. We stand with our customers throughout the entire operating life of their equipment.
about.missionDesc: Keep every knuckle boom crane running safely, efficiently and reliably through genuine parts and standardized technical service.
about.visionDesc: To become the most trusted knuckle boom crane service partner in the Vietnamese market.
about.cap1: A wide genuine parts inventory ready for fast supply
about.cap3: Scheduled maintenance programs with full equipment records
about.cap4: Remote technical support and on-site dispatch when needed
about.teamDesc: Our engineers and technicians bring years of hands-on experience across knuckle boom crane models, continuously trained on the latest technology and maintenance procedures.
about.noteDesc: PALFINGER VIPEC is an authorized parts distribution and technical service partner in the Vietnamese market, not a global representative office of the manufacturer.
